name: Polycab India Ltd
title: Polycab India Ltd - 542652 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Polycab grew Q4 revenue 27% with cable and wire volumes only low single digit, price-led growth; utilisation mid-70s, capex steady at INR 14.8bn for FY26 with market share gains to 30-31%.

capex.quote: During FY26, we incurred capex of INR 14.8 billion, in line with our annual guidance of INR 12 billion to INR 16 billion per annum.

triggers.label: Cumulative price hikes 18-19% Jan-Mar
triggers.quote: we've taken approximately 18% to 19% price hike cumulatively from Jan to March.

triggers.label: Channel primary sales lifted below secondary
triggers.quote: there was definitely some impact in terms of lifting from our distributors, which is our primary sale, primarily because the secondary sale was not moving

triggers.label: Q4 cable/wire volume growth low single digit
triggers.quote: Volume growth for the quarter remained in the low single digits

guidance.quote: we expect the working capital cycle to revert to our steady-state range of 45 to 50 days.
We remain on track to execute our planned capex program of INR 60 billion to INR 80 billion over the next 5 years
in FY28 revenues, we can see some contribution from EHV capacity

red_flags.label: Q4 volume low single digit; revenue growth price-led
red_flags.quote: Volume growth for the quarter remained in the low single digits

red_flags.label: Working capital flattered by LC payables
red_flags.quote: primarily due to temporary increase in payable days arising from use of letter of credit for raw material procurement

evasions.topic: Q4 volume target / March shortfall quantification
evasions.quote: it's very difficult to quantify that.
primarily, we don't give breakup of the intersegment contribution in FMEG.
